name: combobox-49
description: Payment amount input paired with a compact currency combobox showing symbols.

"use client" import * as React from "react" import { Combobox, ComboboxContent, ComboboxEmpty, ComboboxInput, ComboboxItem, ComboboxList, } from "@workspace/ui/components/combobox" import { Field, FieldDescription, FieldLabel, } from "@workspace/ui/components/field" import { InputGroup, InputGroupAddon, InputGroupInput, InputGroupText, } from "@workspace/ui/components/input-group" type Currency = { code: string; symbol: string; name: string } const currencies: Currency[] = [ { code: "USD", symbol: "$", name: "US dollar" }, { code: "EUR", symbol: "€", name: "Euro" }, { code: "GBP", symbol: "£", name: "British pound" }, { code: "JPY", symbol: "¥", name: "Japanese yen" }, { code: "CHF", symbol: "Fr", name: "Swiss franc" }, ] export default function CurrencyAmountInput() { const [currency, setCurrency] = React.useState( currencies[1]! ) return ( Amount
{currency?.symbol ?? "?"} c.code} > No currencies. {(c: Currency) => ( {c.symbol} {c.code} {c.name} )}
Converted at today's mid-market rate. ) }
